mapper.sql: execution_id, group_session_id, source_message_id, reply_to_message_id, initiator_user_id, target_agent_id, candidate_session_id, status, disposition, task_name, ack_text, disposition_time, parent_execution_id, root_message_id, trace_id, gateway_session_id, ack_message_id, answer_message_id, error_code, error_message, attempt, create_time, start_time, finish_time
mapper.select: SELECT FROM byai_group_chat_execution WHERE candidate_session_id = #{candidateSessionId} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE byai_group_chat_execution SET trace_id = #{traceId} WHERE execution_id = #{executionId} AND status = 'RUNNING'
UPDATE byai_group_chat_execution SET status = 'RUNNING', start_time = #{now}, attempt = COALESCE(attempt, 0) + 1 WHERE execution_id = #{executionId} AND status = 'QUEUED'
mapper.select: SELECT FROM byai_group_chat_execution WHERE status = 'QUEUED' ORDER BY create_time ASC, execution_id ASC LIMIT 1
SELECT FROM byai_group_chat_execution WHERE candidate_session_id = #{candidateSessionId} LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE byai_group_chat_execution SET disposition = #{disposition}, task_name = #{taskName}, ack_text = #{ackText}, disposition_time = #{now} WHERE execution_id = #{executionId} AND disposition = 'UNKNOWN'
UPDATE byai_group_chat_execution SET ack_message_id = #{messageId} WHERE execution_id = #{executionId} AND ack_message_id IS NULL
mapper.insert: MERGE INTO byai_group_chat_execution_event target USING ( SELECT CAST(#{executionId} AS BIGINT) AS execution_id, CAST(#{eventId} AS VARCHAR(255)) AS event_id, CAST(#{eventType} AS VARCHAR(64)) AS event_type ) source ON ( target.execution_id = source.execution_id AND target.event_id = source.event_id ) WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (execution_id, event_id, event_type) VALUES (source.execution_id, source.event_id, source.event_type)
mapper.select: SELECT FROM byai_group_chat_execution WHERE status = 'RUNNING' AND start_time < #{before} ORDER BY start_time ASC, execution_id ASC
mapper.update: UPDATE byai_group_chat_execution SET status = CASE WHEN COALESCE(attempt, 0) >= 3 THEN 'FAILED_RETRYABLE' ELSE 'QUEUED' END, start_time = NULL, error_code = CASE WHEN COALESCE(attempt, 0) >= 3 THEN 'STALE_TIMEOUT' ELSE error_code END, error_message = CASE WHEN COALESCE(attempt, 0) >= 3 THEN 'Execution exceeded stale retry limit' ELSE error_message END WHERE status = 'RUNNING' AND start_time < #{before}
mapper.select: SELECT FROM byai_group_chat_execution WHERE status = 'RUNNING' ORDER BY start_time ASC, execution_id ASC
SELECT FROM byai_group_chat_execution WHERE status = 'QUEUED' ORDER BY create_time ASC, execution_id ASC
SELECT FROM byai_group_chat_execution WHERE answer_message_id = #{messageId} OR ack_message_id = #{messageId} LIMIT 1
